application_type_full: Approval of details reserved by a condition (discharge)
decision_conditions: The details submitted are insufficient to satisfy the discharge of condition 5 (Drainage Strategy)of planning permission ref: 25/03897/HOU as the proposed Drainage Strategy fails to demonstrate the development's overall size in relation to proposed SuDs measures as well as utilises inappropriate materials preventing sufficient drainage. The proposal is therefore contrary to Policy CP28 of the Core Strategy, Policies SI12 & SI13 of the London Plan and Policy DMD61 of the Enfield Development Management Document (2014).
description: Details submitted pursuant to reference 25/03897/HOU: external cladding (4) and SuDS (5) in respect of part single, part 2-storey side/rear extension involving demolition of existing garage, inset balcony to rear first floor, rear dormer with rooflights and enlargement of existing rear terrace.
